system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Legendary[1], Salt. 1 item slot (RIS Passive). Attunement. Special Property: Goldstore.

Prerequisites: You are a family member of the Myrgha Oligarchy, Proficiency[4]

A detailed and uniquely ornamental comb carved of mammoth ivory, and inlaid with extremely intricate golden designs.

Goldweave Accessory (Passive): When you have attuned to this comb and have it equipped in a RIS, you may purchase the Goldspool and Goldenhoard abilities if you are a Goldbinder Fatebound.

Rulebook p.35.
